pleaseEnterAValidIpAddress: Please enter a valid IP address.
portMustBeANumberBetween1And65535: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535
thisPortIsAlreadyInTheList: This port is already in the list
configuredPortsAreAllowedOnTheBridge0Eth: Configured ports are allowed on the bridge0, eth0 and tailscale0 interfaces; matching inbound connections on all other interfaces are blocked.
changesTakeEffectImmediatelyAndPersistAc: Changes take effect immediately and persist across reboots. The same port cannot be both blocked and allowed.
allowRulesApplyToAllInterfacesBlockRules: Allow rules apply to all interfaces; block rules allow traffic on the bridge0, eth0 and tailscale0 interfaces, and matching inbound connections on all other interfaces are blocked.
firewallPageDescription: IPv4 port rules, read-only IPv6 chains, DNAT port forwarding and DMZ.

portConflict: The same port cannot be both blocked and allowed
ipv6ReadOnlyNote: IPv6 chains are view-only; editing IPv6 rules is not supported yet.
ipv6LoadFailed: Failed to load IPv6 chain status (ip6tables may be missing on the device)
forwardDangerNote: Port forwarding (DNAT) exposes internal services to external networks. Only forward trusted ports and make sure the target device is secured.
forwardDuplicate: A forwarding rule with the same external port and protocol already exists
invalidInternalIp: Internal IP must be a valid IPv4 address
forwardApplyConfirmMessage: Add {{added}}, remove {{removed}}, modify {{changed}}. The DNAT chain is rebuilt atomically and persisted. Continue?
dmzNote: DMZ forwards all unmatched inbound traffic to the specified host, fully exposing it. Enable with caution.
